entries.title: The Evil Within
entries.definitive_edition: The Evil Within plus Season Pass on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with all Season Pass DLC installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with DLC completeness.

primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best complete route because it can run the base game with the Season Pass DLC on one platform, covering The Assignment, The Consequence, and The Executioner while retaining PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Evil Within on Steam or GOG and add the Season Pass. Play the base campaign first, then The Assignment, The Consequence, and The Executioner.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; the important completeness caveat is installing the Season Pass DLC.

entries.title: The Evil Within 2
entries.definitive_edition: The Evil Within 2 on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release and current update.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with optional first-person mode.

primary.version: Steam/GOG release with first-person mode update
primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it is the full game with PC capture/settings flexibility, and the later free update added an official first-person mode. The PS4 and Xbox One releases have no sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Evil Within 2 on Steam or GOG, update to the current build, and choose third-person or the official first-person mode based on preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or separate definitive edition is documented.
